# cato_secondary_gcp_vsocket (Resource)

Manages the secondary GCP vSocket configuration on an existing compatible GCP site. Does not provision GCP infrastructure. The API requires a registered GCP socket for read and update; new unregistered sockets may be rejected until registration completes. Import using the secondary socket ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure an existing GCP site with an unused secondary slot.
# Provision GCP infrastructure separately and enable the secondary GCP API rollout.
# Use distinct nonreserved addresses within the site's native range.
resource "cato_secondary_gcp_vsocket" "example" {
  site = {
    id = "12345"
    # name = "GCP branch" # Use name instead of id if preferred.
  }
  gcp_config = {
    interface_ip     = "10.20.1.10"
    load_balancer_ip = "10.20.1.20"
  }
}
```

- `gcp_config` (Attributes) Secondary GCP interface and load balancer configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp_config))
- `site` (Attributes) Parent GCP site. Changes require replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))

- `id` (String) Secondary socket ID
